PROPOSAL DESCRIPTION  Blue Diamond Proppants, LLC (BDP) proposes to operate a mobile industrial sands  processing facility in a project area of approximately 16 acres on Parcel # 00-0007-7226,  owned by Ovintiv USA Inc., and located within the A -5 zoning district. As an industrial  use, the proposed operation is permitted within the A-5 zoning district with a conditional  use permit. BDP would process sand excavated on lands in the vicinity previously  approved for industrial sand excavation, using a mobile wet plant. Processed sand would  then be stockpiled for transport . An estimated 600,000 tons of sand is expected to be  processed each year, for an estimated 4.2 million tons over 7 years.
